questions.question: Simplify: (x² - 4) / (x + 2)
questions.explanation: Factor numerator: x² - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2). So (x² - 4)/(x + 2) = (x - 2)(x + 2)/(x + 2) = x - 2 (when x ≠ -2).

questions.question: Simplify: (3x / (x + 1)) + (2 / (x + 1))
questions.explanation: Same denominator: (3x + 2) / (x + 1).

questions.question: Simplify: (2x² - 8) / (x - 2)
What value is excluded from the domain of (x + 3) / (x² - 9)?
questions.explanation: Denominator cannot be zero: x² - 9 ≠ 0 ⇒ (x - 3)(x + 3) ≠ 0 ⇒ x ≠ 3 and x ≠ -3.
